title: The Tin Box Under the Tree  (A Caixa de Lata Sob a Árvore)

scenes.title: Três Pedras ao Norte
scenes.summary: At dawn on Saturday before the upstairs guests wake, Hannah, Graham, and Arthur count three flat flagstones north from the courtyard shade tree.

scenes.title: Envolto em Pano Encerado
scenes.summary: Tessa brings hot morning coffee from the kitchen just as Graham lifts the third stone and uncovers a dry parcel wrapped in heavy waxed cloth.

scenes.title: A Lata de Biscoitos
scenes.summary: Inside sunlit Room 9, Hannah, Tessa, and Arthur untie the waxed cloth to reveal a painted red-and-gold biscuit tin sealed thirty summers ago.

scenes.title: A Bússola de Latão
scenes.summary: Graham eases open the stiff tin lid with a drop of oil, and he and Hannah discover a shining brass pocket compass resting on top.

scenes.title: Quatro Cartões Ilustrados
scenes.summary: Room 4 guest Evelyn and architect Caleb examine four watercolour clue cards from the tin, and Caleb recognises the signature mark of his retired cartography professor.

scenes.title: Metade de uma Receita de Bolo
scenes.summary: In the café corner, Tessa, Evelyn, and Owen read a neatly torn card holding only the top half of the famous summer berry-and-almond cake recipe.

scenes.title: Cinco Jovens Amigos
scenes.summary: Arthur, Evelyn, and Caleb admire a thirty-year-old charcoal sketch from the bottom of the tin showing five smiling friends around a courtyard table.

scenes.title: Andem Por Todas as Quatro Pistas Primeiro
scenes.summary: At the front desk, Hannah, Graham, and Caleb inspect a small wax-sealed envelope instructing them to walk all four neighbourhood clues along Linden Street before breaking the seal.
